summary: Fees were raised by both sides in the first round and negotiated alongside class relief before any final class fund was agreed. The transcript contains an explicit linkage between accepting a fee figure and increasing the class fund, and one plaintiff-side private reasoning note considered whether the fee covered the firm’s time and expenses. There is no clear evidence that class counsel sacrificed class recovery for fees, that defense leveraged fee interests, that a reverse auction occurred, or that the court declaration was misleading.
